This '''Wookiee''' lived in the settlement [[Kiirloor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], with his mate [[Risstenni]] and their son [[Chywarra]]. In circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Chywarra was abducted by the [[Wyrd]] and [[Risstenni]] was captured by them while searching for her son. Risstenni's mate subsequently found a toy [[Ryyk blade/Legends|ryyk blade]] belonging to Chywarra in a wood located near to [[Cloud Mountain]].
